Chup raho, aur samjho.
Sher ki dahad tez hoti hai, lekin uska chup rehna daravna hota hai.
Courage sabhi gunon ki jad hai.
Courage decide karta: fear future decide nahi karega.
Silence sabse powerful scream hai.
Kood pado.
Grit andar ki shakti hai.
Khamoshi mein hi taqat ki jad hai.
Khamoshi weakness nahi—strength hai.
Chuppi mann ka mandir hai.
Asli himmat khamoshi mein bolti hai.
Grit sacrifice maangta.
Khamosh taqat history badalti hai.
Himmat bina takraar ke discipline hai.
Himmat power ki shuruaat hai.
Fear utni hi gehri jitni mind allow kare.
Saahas woh hai jab darr se marna ho, phir bhi savari karna.
Ye hamesha impossible lagta hai, jab tak ho na jaye.
Khamoshi buddhi ke charon taraf baadh hai.
Khamoshi behtar sunne ka pul hai.
